shared_elements: standing human figures in low relief
ornamented costume detail rendered as repeated small motifs
register or band divisions separating zones of figures
justification: Both depict standing human figures carved in relief with headgear and patterned garments, and both divide the surface into horizontal registers or bands, but these are near-universal conventions of relief figuration. A shows long processional files of near-identical figures in profile, all facing one way, with animals in an upper register, whereas B shows a single large frontal figure filling the field, densely surrounded by non-figural sign-like ornament, with no procession, no animals and no repeated file.
